[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/5c6fc50b038c0f31fdbe4e5b5b1763cfd711b4cb.png"]

The deeper you go, the stronger you become… if you survive.

items.text: We’re excited to share v1.2 of Night Swarm, the Vampire Lords update!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/6fb3a08e82c3a99154ede27dffe0dd79140ee5da.png"]
All AI voice overs have been replaced with real voice actors’ recordings.
We worked with 11 different voice artists and rerecorded the full voice over set in a professional studio for a much higher-quality experience.
Two new Vampire Lords join the hunt, each offering a distinct playstyle and new build directions to explore.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/982241f64a21883fb5bd65fe1995953d78b55dfc.png"]
Elowen

Found at the edge of death by the lost Lord himself, Elowen was a human child spared by a final, forbidden act of mercy. Turned into a vampire to survive the night, she was raised alongside Roderic, not as a subject, but as family. Where Roderic charges forward, she watches the shadows, reminding him of what was lost and what must not be forgotten
Edrath

Born of Master Goldrath’s bloodline, Edrath was born unable to walk, yet gifted with a mind that surpassed most vampires. Though physically fragile, his command of arcane knowledge and ancient vampiric lore is unrivaled. To Roderic, Edrath is more than an advisor or mage. He is a brother. Sharp tongued, honest, and fearless, Edrath believes true strength lies not in the body, but in will and understanding.
11 new abilities have been added, expanding build variety and combat options.
These new abilities open up fresh build paths, stronger synergies, and more ways to adapt your playstyle from run to run.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/add9f2b3670ab360468e13bb64c946bf6a32a69c.png"]
Fixed several issues reported by the community.
Improved overall stability and performance in certain scenarios.
Minor visual polish, VFX adjustments, and UI readability improvements.

items.text: Hello everyone! We’re excited to share a major update that adds new long term progression options and more build variety to Night Swarm. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/49605075e5bbb726b3017f4d9581e1e8cabb6a5c.png"]

notes.title: 1) Two New Endgame Buildings: Ore Exchange Machine & Ore Eater

items.text: As more of you reached the endgame, we noticed a common issue: many players were starting to sit on excess endgame resources, and some currencies were gradually losing their meaning once the main progression milestones were completed. We wanted to make sure your late-game runs always feel rewarding and that your hard earned resources keep contributing to your long-term power.

That’s why we’ve added two new endgame buildings to give your extra currencies more value. By investing your endgame resources here, you’ll be able to purchase permanent stat upgrades to strengthen your character over time.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/e17b735ae717ba994720babcfdc11e6e42dd2bdf.png"]

We’ve also seen that players who push deeper especially in Endless Mode need more ways to scale and specialize their builds. Once you reach a certain point, survival and damage often come down to having more meaningful item choices and stronger build identities, not just “more of the same stats.”

To support deeper runs and more variety, we’ve introduced a brand new Set Item system! Collect and combine set pieces to unlock powerful bonuses and create more specialized builds. Our goal here is to give you exciting “chase” items and clearer build directions as you progress.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/a4a02051101f35bc44db83ced786289a1232c18b.png"]
Finally, we wanted to ensure that progression doesn’t feel “done” too quickly.

So we’ve expanded the Talent Tree with new talents and more options, giving you more ways to customize your playstyle and progression. This update is designed to keep long term growth meaningful, while letting you experiment with different builds more easily.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/07715ac4cc34409f05cacebca3ef2b9ce7a0d37f.png"]
We’re already working on the next wave of content and improvements, planned for February:
New playable characters
New active relics and fused relics
Professional studio voice-overs (we’re replacing the current AI VO with professionally recorded lines)
As always, thank you for your support your feedback helps shape the game. 💛
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/a56ba8a010c8db8e7f6f7543322e516146abf2d7.png"]
We've just deployed a significant update focusing on performance improvements and bug fixes. Thank you for all your valuable feedback!
Endless Run Performance: Implemented major performance updates specifically for the Endless Run mode to ensure a smoother late-game experience.
Steam Deck Quality of Life: Various Quality of Life (QoL) improvements have been made to enhance the experience for players on the Steam Deck.
Igor Quests Completion: Fixed an issue where quests tied to finding specific Igor items could not be completed.
Igor Companion Upgrade: Added retroactive support for the Igor Companion Upgrade.
Green Relic Totem: Fixed a bug preventing the Green Relic Totem from appearing/spawning.
Relic Refresh Freeze: Resolved a bug that caused the game to freeze or hang when using the Relic Refresh feature.
Level Progression: Fixed an issue where level progression incorrectly continued after the player chose to "Give Up."
Unlock Quest Progress: Fixed a bug that prevented item dismount/disenchant quests (part of the Unlock Quests) from progressing correctly.
Igor Quest Display: Fixed an issue that caused Igor's "Echoes of Grandeur" quest to display incorrectly.
Rune Upgrade Limits: Fixed a problem that allowed Rune Upgrades to exceed their maximum intended level.
This update addresses all of the major feedback and issues reported by the community. Thank you to everyone who shared detailed reports. It helped us a lot.
Autocannon POI now activates 2x faster and continuously fires while rotating in one direction.

notes.title: 🛠️ Major Update - Balance Changes, QoL Improvements, & Bug Fixes

items.text: Hi everyone!
We’ve been listening closely to your feedback and today we’re releasing a major update focusing on balance, progression improvements, drop rate tuning, and a large set of bug fixes.
Let’s dive in! 👇
Goblins now show up on the minimap after you spot them for the first time.
Removed the Scroll upgrade system for items, items now drop directly.
Companion abilities are now visible even before unlocking them.

The scroll system has been reworked to make the inventory system much clearer and easier to understand. Chance based upgrades have been removed. All of your existing scrolls will be converted into items.
The chance to find a magnet in levels has been increased from 50% to 100%.
Frozen enemies can now be refrozen after a short cooldown.
When discarding Relics/Artifacts taken from Totems, you now receive 50% gold refund.
Talent prices have been adjusted for smoother progression.
Item Totem prices have been significantly reduced.
Increased Collect Range.
Island unlock order has been updated for a better flow.
Increased Goblin drops; Goblins can now drop Bloodstones.
Increased Bloodstone drop rate in Endless mode.
Increased Rune drop rate.
Increased drop rates from breakable props.
Increased drop rates for Echoes of Grandeur.
Increased Elite item drop rate.
Increased rerolls from 1 → 2.
Quest reputation rewards doubled.
Igor reputation gains doubled, with some quest requirements nerfed.
Global companion mana regeneration increased.
Buffed the passive card that increases companion mana regen.
Major early-game balance improvements.
Reduced Goblin HP.
Helldog has been nerfed.
Pickup Radius wording updated to percentage-based for better clarity.
Fixed an issue where settings did not transfer correctly between devices.
Fixed a bug preventing correct level gain after consecutive Events/Campfires.
Fixed the bug where the gold & HP received from Campfires didn't carry over to the game.
Fixed the Apprentice achievement.
Fixed Hellsong's hat quest, where the hat couldn't be found.
Fixed missing glyph sprites.
Fixed navigation issues in the Castle when pausing.
Fixed an issue where Talents did not display in character stats.
Fixed Collection tasks appearing completed when not finished.
Prevented dismantling of equipped items by removing the dismantle option when an equipped item is selected.
Optimized several debuffs that were causing performance problems.
Various additional performance and stability fixes.
Your feedback plays a vital role in shaping the game to perfection.
Stay tuned for the roadmap soon! 🚀

notes.title: 🦇 Get Ready for Steam Next Fest — October 13 – 20!

items.text: The Night Swarm demo is getting a special update just in time for Next Fest! From October 13 – 20, you’ll be able to experience new features, modes, and systems designed to push your survival skills to the limit.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/fdf333f8140d8664b1887333eb32366f8f22b69a.png"]
We’ve reached a huge milestone in the development of Night Swarm: The Eyles Update!

This chapter introduces the long-awaited arrival of the game’s main villain, Lord Eyles, alongside brand-new Relics, fearsome new Boss encounters, and fresh NPCs that deepen the world, its story, and its gameplay.
Most of these additions are also included in the updated demo, so you can jump in and experience the next stage of Night Swarm’s evolution right now.
Don’t forget to share your thoughts with us. Your feedback plays a big role in shaping our decisions as development continues, so stay tuned here for more updates!
· Arachne, the Cursed Weaver – A new character who spins deadly Shadow Silks to ensnare his foes.
· Corvus Returns – Once vanished with our Lord, this noble of the castle is back, ready to teach us how to wield the power of Ancient Blood.
· Mr. Selim, the Restorer – Oversees the restoration of the castle, shaping it according to our wishes as its new leader.
· New Biomes – Venture beyond the castle walls to defend surrounding regions, each with distinct conditions and threats.
· Unique Enemies per Biome – Every biome features its own roster of foes, including deadly elites and terrifying bosses.
· Lord Eyles – The ultimate nemesis steps forth. More than a final boss, he curses us with mechanics that make every journey more dangerous.
· New Missions – Fresh quests from Igor and renewed Hunter Lessons from Master Hellsong.
· Points of Interest – Discover new locations across the world where meaningful interactions await.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/d499c0daf67436f4af3b4a2a2c7cbb7f8b0090a7.png"]
Deep within the castle lives Arachne, a chubby yet oddly endearing resident cursed with spider legs. Though marked by his fate, he welcomes us warmly — and offers something no one else can.

By bringing his Shadow Silk, Arachne weaves mysterious garments spun from the threads of destiny. These aren’t just outfits — they are the very heart of the item system. Every piece he creates alters the way we fight and survive.

The higher the difficulty, the greater the rewards: tougher challenges allow us to gather larger amounts of Shadow Silk, which in turn unlocks rarer, more powerful equipment. Arachne’s loom binds progression, challenge, and choice into one — every thread pulling us deeper into the curse.

notes.title: 🩸 Lady Corvus, Keeper of Ancient Blood

items.text: When Lord Eyles vanished, so too did Lady Corvus, one of the castle’s ancient vampires. Her disappearance shrouded the halls in mystery, but if we uncover the truth and bring her back, she may yet share her forbidden knowledge.

Corvus holds the secrets of reshaping our blood-born powers — unique vampiric abilities that flow directly from the heart. With her ancient teachings, we gain the means to redefine and customize our own blood magic, bending it in ways once thought lost to time.

Despite her snow-white hair, Corvus appears youthful and delicate, her presence both elegant and unnerving. Yet the greatest question remains unanswered: will this timeless vampire truly accept us as the castle’s new Lord, or will she resist the change of power?

Among the castle’s cursed halls dwells Mr. Selim, a master craftsman with the rare ability to shape its very foundations. Through the power of Echoes of Grandeur, he can bend even the ancient, unyielding walls of this enchanted fortress to our will.

Under his careful hands, the long-faded castle slowly regains its former splendor, echoing the glorious days of old. Yet Mr. Selim’s talents go beyond simple restoration — he answers to our personal requests, ensuring the fortress reflects our reign as its new Lord.

One such project is the construction of Roderic’s Hobby Room, a unique chamber where bold new ideas take form. This room promises to host discoveries, strategies, and tools that may aid us in the dark struggle ahead.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/19eab7c0452211a7ccb6dbf418193f2c75f68005.png"]

notes.title: 🌍 New Biomes Along the Road to Eyles’ Fortress

items.text: The path from our stronghold to Lord Eyles’ castle is no longer a simple march — it is a gauntlet of cursed lands, each twisted by the shadows of his dominion.
* The Scorched Deserts: Sunlight burns as fiercely as moonlight, cursing these sands with unending heat. Day and night alike, travelers are seared by the torment of an eternal blaze.
* The Frozen Battlegrounds: Once a site of war, now a grave of ice. The chilling breath of lost souls freezes the air itself, leaving every step haunted by the cold whispers of the fallen.
* The Ravaged Forests: Once lush, now devoured by nocturnal horrors. Cursed night-creatures prowl beneath dead canopies, their eyes glowing with hunger in the dark.
* The Forgotten Stronghold: A colossal fortress, abandoned since ancient wars, yet forever marked by Eyles’ presence. It is said he commanded his armies here, and the ruins still carry his iron will.
Each biome brings not only unique enemies, elites, and bosses, but also environments that test endurance in new ways — heat, cold, darkness, and despair themselves become weapons in the journey.

Igor’s fractured mind offers us pieces of the past, half-remembered fragments that slowly take shape as missions. Through his scattered memory, we begin to recall our purpose — and with each recollection, greater challenges rise before us.

On this harsher path, memory alone will not be enough. We will need new weapons and new methods to endure. Master Hellsong knows this well. His lessons have been reshaped, his talent tree expanded, branching toward the trials yet to come. Within its depths lie powers designed for the battles that only grow darker.

Before the age of decline, Lord Eyles was more than a loyal follower — he was one of the most powerful and influential vampire lords within the castle. Unlike others who reveled in aristocratic decadence, he feared that such indulgence would drown their kind in weakness and obscurity. To prevent this downfall, he vowed to do anything necessary to make vampires supreme once more.

Now he stands not only as an endgame foe, but as a force that reshapes the battlefield itself. Through curses of ancient magic, he warps every encounter, turning each step of our journey into a struggle against his will. His presence also threatens to fracture our bonds with allies inside the castle, testing loyalties and straining relationships as much as blades and blood. Lord Eyles is more than a final enemy — he is a shadow over every choice we make.

Countless cracks have been mended, and with them the castle stands sturdier than before. Bugs have been fixed, performance improved, and the game now runs far smoother — granting you higher frame rates and a sharper experience in every battle.
Our efforts to optimize the foundations of Night Swarm mean not only a more stable journey, but also the strength to build even greater horrors upon it.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586397/9227fb492cbaf905a939c5fce1f456ffcbee2bae.png"]
✦ Closing Words ✦

Some of these changes are bound for the full game alone, while others will be included in the updated demo launching on October 10 during the Steam Next Fest. You’ll be able to experience much of this progress then and we’d love to hear your thoughts once you dive in.
Your feedback shapes our path, guiding us as we push Night Swarm further into the darkness. Stay tuned here for our next announcement, where we’ll finally reveal the release date.
